login.title: Sign in to Rec PM
login.subtitle: Use your email and password.
login.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email before signing in. We sent a new link to {{email}}.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Your workspace starts with a 14-day Profissional trial.
signup.invitedSubtitle: Create your account to accept the invitation.
signup.terms: I have read and accept the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
signup.checkEmail: Account created. We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to create a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, the link will arrive shortly. It is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.description: {{inviter}} invited you to the {{workspace}} workspace as {{role}}.
invite.needVerify: Confirm your email to accept the invitation. Check your inbox.
invite.resent: We sent a new confirmation link.
invite.notFound: Invitation not found, expired, or sent to another email.

workspaces.title: Your workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: Choose where you want to work.
workspaces.empty: You are not part of any workspace yet.
workspaces.createDescription: One workspace per agency. Starts with a 14-day Profissional trial.

dashboard.intro: This is your {{workspace}} workspace. Here's a summary of your day; reports and finance arrive in later phases.
dashboard.inviteTeamDesc: Managers and staff join through the invitation link.
dashboard.secureAccountDesc: Protect your account with an authenticator app.

members.title: Users
members.subtitle: Who has access to this workspace.
members.inviteDescription: They will get an email link, valid for 7 days.
members.empty: Just you here. Invite your team.
members.emptyPortal: No client portal users yet. Invite them from the client page.
members.clientHint: They will only see this client's projects.
members.ownRole: You can't change your own role.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {{name}}?
deactivate.text: They lose access to this workspace immediately. Their work history stays.

reset.title: Send a password reset to {{name}}?
reset.text: A reset link goes to {{email}}, valid for 1 hour.

fields.hourlyCostHint: Used in cost reports. Only admins see it.

hours.title: Working hours
hours.inherit: Follows the workspace default hours. Task time only counts inside them.

security.title: Account security
security.twoFactorDesc: Besides your password, sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
security.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app and enter the generated code.
security.backupHint: Keep these codes somewhere safe. Each one works once if you lose your phone.

portal.title: Client portal
portal.soon: The client portal arrives in Phase 9. Nothing to show here yet.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least {{min}} characters.
validation.slug: Use 3 to 48 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
validation.terms: You must accept the terms to continue.

billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.subtitle: Your plan, task quota usage and upgrade options.
billing.notConfigured: Online payment is not configured in this environment yet. The trial and the free plan work normally.
billing.trialLine_one: Free trial: {{count}} day left (until {{date}}). Then the workspace moves to Básico unless subscribed.
billing.trialLine_other: Free trial: {{count}} days left (until {{date}}). Then the workspace moves to Básico unless subscribed.
billing.pastDueLine: Payment overdue. Settle it by {{date}} to avoid read-only mode.
billing.cancelScheduled: The subscription ends on {{date}}; then the workspace returns to Básico.
billing.checkoutReturn: Payment sent. Your plan updates as soon as the provider confirms it.
billing.confirmText: You stay on {{plan}} until {{date}}. The change applies from the next cycle and nothing is deleted.

changed.upgrade: Upgraded. The new limit applies now.
changed.downgrade: Change scheduled for the next cycle.
changed.cancel_at_period_end: The subscription ends at the end of the cycle.
changed.schedule_free: Change scheduled for the next cycle.

banner.readOnly: Workspace is read-only due to non-payment. Nothing was deleted.
banner.pastDue: We couldn't charge the subscription. Settle it by {{date}} to avoid read-only mode.
banner.nearLimit: You have used {{pct}}% of this cycle's plan tasks.
banner.limitReached: This cycle's plan task limit has been reached.

upgrade.PLAN_TASK_LIMIT_REACHED: This cycle's plan task limit has been reached.
upgrade.PLAN_USER_LIMIT_REACHED: The current plan can't hold more users.
upgrade.FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN: This feature isn't part of the current plan.

platform.title: Platform
platform.search: Search by name, slug or e-mail

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}
suspend.text: Nobody in the workspace can use the app until it is reactivated.

impersonate.title: Sign in as admin of {{name}}
impersonate.text: You browse as the workspace admin for up to 1 hour. Start and end are logged.

plan.title: Assign a plan to {{name}}
plan.text: Grants the plan without charging for the chosen period (e.g. Enterprise closed by sales).

platform.editPlanText: Changes apply to new charges. Running subscriptions keep the provider's price.

sortable.handle: Reorder {{name}} (drag or use the arrow keys)

catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.subtitle: The lists this workspace uses in projects, tasks and reports. Drag to reorder.

help.task-types: Each type sets estimated hours and a checklist on the task, and whether it counts as a delivered piece.
help.kanban-columns: The task workflow stages. A column's key never changes; name, color and order can.
help.project-types: E.g. One-off, Monthly, Event, Music video.
help.report-categories: Group task types in reports (Art, Video…). Types without a category show as "Other".
help.adjustment-reasons: Reasons picked when a task goes back for revisions.
help.sectors: Agency teams, used in the productivity scoreboard.
help.task-roles: Roles on a task: editor, designer, videomaker, copywriter…
help.briefings: Questions the team or the client answer when requesting work.

catalogs.deleteText: Only items never used can be deleted. If it's in use, deactivate it.

taskType.categoryHint: Where deliveries of this type add up in reports.
taskType.countsAsPieceHint: Deliveries of this type count in productivity and contracted × delivered.
taskType.sellableHint: Shows up in the project's contract items.
taskType.usableAsTypeHint: Uncheck for types that only exist as contract items.
taskType.checklistHint: One item per line. Copied to the task when this type is chosen.

column.isApprovalHint: Entering it notifies the task approver; approving moves on, rejecting goes back to revisions.
column.isFinalHint: Marks the task as done. Only one column can be final.
column.deleteText: Only empty columns outside the workflow rules can be deleted.

briefing.question: Question
briefing.optionsHint: One option per line (at least two).
briefing.badField: Check question {{n}}: it needs text and, for choices, at least two options.

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: Clients, hour balance and portal access.
clients.search: Search by name, code, e-mail or tax id
clients.emptyText: Add your first client to create projects for them.
clients.hoursHelp: Contracted = contract items of active projects × the type's estimated hours. Spent = business hours logged on this client's tasks this month.

portal.title: Portal users
portal.text: People at the client who follow projects and request work.
portal.empty: Nobody from this client has access yet.

clients.deleteHelp: Only a client without projects or portal users can be deleted. With history, deactivate it.
clients.deactivateText: The client disappears from lists and can't get new projects. Nothing is deleted.

files.noneText: Upload files or keep links (Drive, WeTransfer, Frame.io).

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Each client's contracts, schedule and deliverables.
projects.emptyText: Create the first project to organize a client's tasks.
projects.timelineEmptyText: Set start and delivery dates to see projects on the timeline.
projects.undated_one: {{count}} project without dates is not shown.
projects.undated_other: {{count}} projects without dates are not shown.
projects.deleteText: The project and all its tasks disappear from lists. Used quota is not refunded.
projects.columnsHelp: Hide columns this project doesn't use or rename them. The workflow stays the same.
projects.columnLabel: Name of column {{name}} in this project
projects.contractHelp: What was sold per period and how much is done.
projects.writeComment: Write a comment for the team…
projects.visibleToClient: Show to the client in the portal
projects.noPhases: No phases. Phases show progress per stage (e.g. Script, Shoot, Edit).
projects.noMilestones: No milestones. Project dates show up here automatically.
projects.shiftDaysHint: E.g. 30 for the next monthly cycle. Applies to project dates and task deadlines.
projects.includeTasksHint: Each copied task counts toward the plan quota.
projects.noTeam: No one on the team yet. Edit the project to add people.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: Everything the team has to deliver, with filters kept in the page address.
tasks.emptyText: Change the filters or create a task.
tasks.showing: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}}. Refine the filters to see the rest.
tasks.requestArchiveHelp: A manager will approve or decline the request.
tasks.deleteText: The task disappears from lists. Used quota is not refunded.
tasks.drawerHelp: Task details. Each field saves on its own.

adjustment.title: Send to revisions
adjustment.help: Give the reason: it feeds the rework report.

time.title: Time
time.none: Nobody has tracked time on this task yet.
time.reworkHelp: Time tracked while the task was in Adjustments.
time.adjustmentHelp: The adjustment only counts in reports after a manager approves it.

workingNow.title: Working now
workingNow.subtitle: Who is on which task right now, in business hours.
workingNow.empty: Nobody has an active task right now
workingNow.emptyText: When someone clicks “I'm on it”, they show up here instantly.
workingNow.noHistory: No time entries in this period.

approvals.title: Time adjustments
approvals.subtitle: Team requests to fix tracked time. They only count in reports once approved.
approvals.subtitleMine: Your requests to fix tracked time. Request one from the task drawer, in the Time section.
approvals.emptyMineText: Open a task and use “Request time adjustment” in the Time section.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace rules: hours, productivity, branding, AI and integrations.

help.operation: Time zone, default business hours and the deadlines that trigger alerts.
help.productivity: Scoring weights for the team and highlight of the month.
help.branding: Colors and logo used in the app and the client portal.
help.ai: OpenAI-compatible provider for the chat assistant.
help.api-keys: Keys for the public API (/api/v1). Each key acts with its creator's permissions.

operation.slaHint: A card in “Waiting for client” longer than this alerts the account manager.
operation.idleHint: Used in the account management penalty.
operation.hoursHint: Applies to anyone without their own hours. “I'm on it” time only counts inside them, excluding holidays and days off.

productivity.note: Scores appear in the productivity reports (Phase 8).

branding.imageOnly: Upload an image (PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP).
branding.note: The primary color updates the app right away for the whole team.

ai.name: Assistant name
ai.keySet: Key configured. Leave empty to keep it.
ai.note: The key is stored encrypted and is never shown again. AI chat arrives in Phase 6.

apiKeys.newHelp: Give it a name that reminds you where it's used (e.g. Zapier).
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.createdHelp: For security it won't be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
apiKeys.emptyText: Create a key to integrate Rec PM with other tools.
apiKeys.note: Send it in the header Authorization: Bearer pk_live_…. The full public API (docs and webhooks) arrives in Phase 9.

notifications.settingsSubtitle: Choose how you hear about each thing: in the bell, by email or on your phone/computer.
notifications.byTypeHint: Turning off "In app" removes it from the bell. Email and push follow what is checked here.
notifications.pushHint: Turn on in this browser to get alerts even with Rec PM closed. On iPhone, add the app to the home screen first.
notifications.pushDenied: The browser blocked notifications. Allow them in the site settings.
notifications.pushUnavailable: Push isn't configured on the server yet.
notifications.pushNotSupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Project schedule, team agenda and deliveries in one place.
calendar.eventHint: Meetings, trainings, days off and important dates.
calendar.teamHint: Birthdays come from each person's profile.
calendar.emptyHint: Change the period or filters, or create an event.

holidays.title: National holidays
holidays.hint: We import Brazil's national holidays from BrasilAPI. They show as days off in the calendar and business hours.
holidays.off: Off: no national holidays in the calendar.

chat.pickHint: Or start a new one with a teammate, a group or the assistant.
chat.newHint: Talk to one person or set up a group.
chat.aiHint: Answers from the projects and tasks you can see.
chat.aiEmpty: Ask about tasks, projects or request a briefing draft.
chat.groupAdminHint: You manage this group: change name and photo, add or remove people.
chat.groupMemberHint: See who's here or leave the conversation.
